demo.text: Call our demo line and talk to Voicia the way your customers would. It plays a member of our sales team: it asks about your business and how you handle calls today.

script.text: Hello, you've reached Voicia, I'm the assistant. Are you calling about your business calls?
Yes, I run a small plumbing company in Namur and I miss a lot of calls on jobs.
I see. Roughly how many calls a day, and what happens to the ones you can't take?
Ten to fifteen. Most go to voicemail, and people rarely leave a message.
Voicia would answer each one in your company's name and send you a brief, so you call back the important ones first. Shall I book a setup call?

keepNumber.q: Can I keep my phone number?
keepNumber.a: Yes. Forward your existing number to Voicia, or use the number assigned to your assistant.

setupTime.a: Typically the same day. The Voicia team sets everything up with you.

replaceTeam.a: No. Voicia can transfer a call to a person, and writes a brief for every other call so your team can follow up.
